Resource Profile: ServiceRequest - FR Service Request Imaging Document

Official URL: https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/document-core/StructureDefinition/fr-service-request-imaging-document Version: 0.1.0-ballot
Draft as of 2026-11-17 Computable Name: FRServiceRequestImagingDocument

FRServiceRequestImagingDocument profil spécifique permet de porter des demandes d'examens d'imagerie.

Usages:

  • Refer to this Profile: DiagnosticReport - FR Diagnostic Report Imaging Document, ImagingStudy - FR Imaging study Document, Observation - FR Observation Radiation Exposure Document and Observation - FR Observation Result Document

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
